subject: MAP cadence: Highland Health expansion - readiness & blockers
message_1_subject: MAP kickoff: draft timeline & outstanding items
message_1_body:
Hi Elena / Tom,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — attached is an updated MAP (v3) that reflects the expansion scope we discussed (new teams: Provider Ops + Clinical Insights, initial pilot 20 users, add-ons: real-time embeddings).

Key open items before we can lock the pilot start date:
- Procurement: signed PO and billing contact (owner: Highland procurement)
- Legal: one-line SLA tweak around data retention, Highland legal to confirm redlines
- Security: SOC 2 evidence we previously shared — please confirm receipt
- Enablement: CS runbook & training slots (owner: Redwood CS)

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm procurement timing and any legal redline priorities this week
2) We ship a tightened SLA for signature (if needed) + updated MAP milestones
3) Quick enablement planning call next Tue (30 min) to lock dates

I attached the MAP (Highland_MAP_v3.xlsx) with owners and a proposed two-week adjusted timeline if procurement slips.

If you prefer a short call instead of email updates, happy to book.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: Highland_MAP_v3.xlsx (xlsx) - MAP with owners, milestone dates, and success criteria
message_2_subject: Re: MAP kickoff: draft timeline & outstanding items
message_2_body:
On Tue, Sep 21, 2026 at 3:02 PM marissa.cole@redwood.com wrote:
> Thanks again for the time yesterday — attached is an updated MAP (v3)...

Marissa — thanks for the clear summary. Two quick blockers from our side that will affect dates:

1) Procurement: our finance team has a vendor onboarding queue; earliest PO sign-off is looking like 10/12. I don’t have control over the queue but I can follow up.
2) Legal: they flagged a retention line in the SLA that needs a small redline. I attached the section with our comments.

If those two items hold, we should shift the pilot start by ~2 weeks. We still want the expansion — just need the updated dates.

Can you send a version of the SLA with the proposed redline addressed so legal can sign off faster? Also, can your CS team hold two alternate enablement slots in the week of 10/18 in case we get the PO in time?

Appreciate it — cc’ing Tom for schedule alignment.

Best,
Elena
Elena Morales | Dir, Data & Analytics, Highland Health
elena.morales@highlandhealth.com

Attachment: Highland_SLA_redlines_v1.pdf (pdf) - Highland legal comments on retention clause
message_3_body:
Marissa / Neha — quick internal note after Elena’s reply:

Summary:
- Procurement likely earliest sign by 10/12 (two-week slip)
- Legal flagged retention clause; attached redlines from Elena

Immediate asks:
- Neha: can CS tentatively reserve two enablement slots in week of 10/18? Prefer mornings PST. Also confirm whether we can run the pilot with a phased enablement (Core users first, then expanded cohort).
- Marissa: I’ll have Legal draft the SLA update addressing retention and push for a faster turn. I’ll coordinate with Contracts to prepare an expedited DocuSign when ready.

If procurement actually clears sooner we’ll revert to original dates. For planning, let’s assume the +2 week plan so internal teams can block calendars.

Thanks — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
message_4_subject: Re: MAP cadence: Highland Health expansion - readiness & blockers
message_4_body:
Elena / Tom — appreciate the heads up. We’ll proceed with the adjusted timeline and prioritize the legal redline so you can sign quickly.

What we’re doing this week:
- Contracts (Rishi) will send an updated SLA v2 with the proposed retention language change by EOD Thu (9/24).
- I’ve asked CS (Neha) to tentatively hold two enablement slots in week of 10/18 (mornings PST) — she’ll confirm availability tomorrow.
- I’ll update the MAP milestones to reflect a pilot start target of 10/19 and circulate an executive one-pager for Highland leadership.

Next checkpoint: 30-min touch on Tue 9/28 to confirm procurement status and finalize sign-off plan. Proposal: Tue 9/28 9:00 AM PT. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda: 1) procurement status, 2) SLA sign, 3) enablement slots, 4) pilot go/no-go decision.

Also attaching the SLA v2 for sign-off (SLA_v2_for-signing.pdf) and a link to the updated MAP in Drive.

Thanks,
Marissa
Attachment: SLA_v2_for-signing.pdf (pdf) - Contracts updated retention line; ready for DocuSign
